root.name: キューリグ・ドクターペッパー

relations.text: 2025年の連結純売上高の約16%を占める最大の小売顧客
relations.text_en: Walmart is its largest retailer, about 16% of consolidated net sales in 2025

source.label: キューリグ・ドクターペッパー 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.label_en: Keurig Dr Pepper 10-K (fiscal year ended December 31, 2025)
source.quote: Our largest retailer, Walmart, represented approximately 16% of our consolidated net sales in 2025.

relations.text_en: Coca-Cola is named among its primary competitors

source.label: キューリグ・ドクターペッパー 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.label_en: Keurig Dr Pepper 10-K (fiscal year ended December 31, 2025)
source.quote: Our primary competitors include Coca-Cola, PepsiCo, Starbucks Corporation, The J.M. Smucker Company, The Kraft Heinz Company, and Nestlé S.A.

relations.text: 一部地域では、同社のドクターペッパーの製造・販売権をコカ・コーラなどが持つ
relations.text_en: In many countries, third parties including competitors such as Coca-Cola own the manufacturing and distribution rights to its CSD brands

source.label: キューリグ・ドクターペッパー 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.label_en: Keurig Dr Pepper 10-K (fiscal year ended December 31, 2025)
source.quote: In many countries outside the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, the manufacturing and distribution rights to many of our CSD brands, including our Dr Pepper trademark and formula, are owned by third parties, including, in certain cases, competitors such as Coca-Cola.

relations.text_en: PepsiCo is named among its primary competitors

companies.name: ビタココ
companies.sub: ココナッツウォーター

relations.text: 2025年末時点のパートナーブランドにココナッツウォーターのビタココが入る
relations.text_en: Vita Coco coconut water was part of its partner brand portfolio as of December 31, 2025

source.label: キューリグ・ドクターペッパー 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.label_en: Keurig Dr Pepper 10-K (fiscal year ended December 31, 2025)
source.quote: As of December 31, 2025, our portfolio of partner brands included C4 energy drinks, Electrolit instant hydration beverages, Vita Coco coconut water, Bloom energy drinks and prebiotic sodas, evian water, Polar Beverages seltzer water, La Colombe shelf-stable RTD coffee, and Black Rifle Coffee Company energy drinks.

relations.text: 2025年末時点のパートナーブランドにエナジードリンクが入る
relations.text_en: Black Rifle Coffee Company energy drinks were part of its partner brand portfolio as of December 31, 2025

source.label: キューリグ・ドクターペッパー 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.label_en: Keurig Dr Pepper 10-K (fiscal year ended December 31, 2025)
source.quote: As of December 31, 2025, our portfolio of partner brands included C4 energy drinks, Electrolit instant hydration beverages, Vita Coco coconut water, Bloom energy drinks and prebiotic sodas, evian water, Polar Beverages seltzer water, La Colombe shelf-stable RTD coffee, and Black Rifle Coffee Company energy drinks.
